title: Yukari Windshield Ghiaia Glossy Tortoise, D+ Mineral Glass
body_html:
Made in Japan.
The Yukari Windshield Ghiaia is a six base frame inspired by heritage Italian eyewear. The frame is constructed from TR90 injected nylon with betatitanium armature and hardware, and is the first to feature D+ Mineral Glass lenses. The glass lenses provide high optical clarity with minimal distortion and strong surface scratch resistance. Their greater density compared with polycarbonate adds perceptible weight to the frame, reinforcing a period-correct balance and the substantial, tactile feel of traditional eyewear. A fully adjustable and hypoallergenic rubber nose pad and temple tips provide a secure and customizable fit.

title: Koharu Eclipse, Flint/D+ G15 Silver Flash Mirror
body_html:
Made in Japan.

Koharu Eclipse is a six base frame construction defining a new approach to unisex sports eyewear. The ergonomic form is engineered to aid ventilation and enhance the field of vision. The 125mm temples are architected for helmet use. Adjustable nose pads and temple tips ensure a secure, personalized fit, reinforced with a grade 2 titanium core in the temple tips for added strength. Our signature D+ therapeutic-grade lenses are crafted from a shatterproof polycarbonate compound. The interior surfaces feature anti-reflective and oleophobic coatings, providing comprehensive eye protection while repelling water and oil.D+ Silver Flash was developed for physical pursuits requiring maximum sun protection. The mirror coating facilitates additional infrared screening. The lens offers 100% UVA/B protection while transmitting 10.29% of visible light and 9.70% of blue light.

title: Junya Racer PAF Iris, D+ Blue Gradient
body_html:
Made in Japan.

The Post Archive Faction (PAF) Junya Racer features custom lens cuts developed exclusively for this collaboration. Inspired by the lightweight structure of bird and butterfly wings, the sculpted geometry removes select areas of material to reduce weight while maintaining stability. This biomimetic approach introduces subtle aerodynamic cues that help guide airflow around the face during movement. Despite the reduced material, the design remains fully compliant with CE, UKCA, and ISO protection standards. The six base blade style frame is designed to protect the eyes and enhance the field of vision. Fitted with a hand sculpted lens and custom shaped temples for running and cycling. The frame features D+ lens technology, an adjustable hypoallergenic rubber nose pad and temple tips with a titanium core. D+ Blue Gradient was developed for physical pursuits in medium light conditions. The lens offers 100% UVA/B protection while transmitting 42.3% of visible light.

title: Kohei Aero Blade Ti Jadeite, D+ Copper Mirror
body_html:
Made in Japan.
The Kohei Aero Blade Ti is a six base rimless blade style proprietary sunglass system featuring a frame composed entirely of ultra lightweight and durable aerospace grade titanium. The frame features custom anodized titanium hardware, hypoallergenic rubber nose pads, temple tips and utilizes our signature D+ therapeutic grade lenses, constructed from shatterproof polycarbonate compound. The lens interiors are treated with both anti-reflective and oleophobic coatings for holistic eye protection and water and oil repellency. Lens shaping and profile draws inspiration from heritage 1980's speed cycling where aerodynamic considerations and protection carry equal weighting. D+ Copper Mirror mitigates reflected light and allows 10.03% of visible light transmission, 6.06% of blue light transmission, and blocks 100% of UVA/UVB rays.

*The temple tips on our titanium frames are fixed and do not rotate. For a precise fit, adjustments can be made by a licensed optician.

title: Performance Lab Waterproof Jacket, Powder Blue
body_html:
Built for demanding conditions, the Performance Lab Waterproof Jacket is constructed from Polartec® AirCore™, a highly breathable, non-PFAS 3-layer fabric engineered to balance weather protection and airflow during high-output activity. Made with recycled face and backing fabrics, AirCore™ features a hydrophobic nanofiber membrane created through electrospinning, producing microscopic filaments approximately 100 times smaller than a human hair. The air-permeable membrane allows heat and moisture vapor to escape while providing protection from wind and rain, with stretch for unrestricted movement in variable conditions. Details include fully bonded seams with a repeating wordmark, waterproof zippers, adjustable cuffs, and a structured hood for added protection. Flat pockets and the zippered front placket are finished with metal buttons, referencing traditional sportswear detailing within a technical construction.

title: Konoha Sun Sprinter, Black/D+ Onyx Mirror
body_html:
Made in Japan.

Adjustable nose pads and temple tips ensure a secure, personalized fit, reinforced with a grade 2 titanium core in the temple tips for added strength. Our signature D+ therapeutic-grade lenses are crafted from a shatterproof polycarbonate compound. The interior surfaces feature anti-reflective and oleophobic coatings, providing comprehensive eye protection while repelling water and oil. D+ Onyx Mirror was developed for physical pursuits requiring maximum sun protection. The mirror coating facilitates additional infrared screening. The lens offers 100% UVA/B protection while transmitting 16.19% of visible light and 15.99% of blue light.

Adjustable nose pads and temple tips ensure a secure, personalized fit, reinforced with a grade 2 titanium core in the temple tips for added strength. Our signature D+ therapeutic-grade lenses are crafted from a shatterproof polycarbonate compound. The interior surfaces feature anti-reflective and oleophobic coatings, providing comprehensive eye protection while repelling water and oil. Our D+ G15 lens technology was tested by our runners and made in Japan. The lens offers 100% UVA/B protection while transmitting 11.57% of visible light and 7.21% of blue light.

title: Kilcarra Wool Cardigan, Midnight Tweed
body_html:
The Kilcarra Cardigan is made in Italy from Irish milled heavyweight Kilcarra Donegal tweed wool, balancing natural insulation with exceptional durability. The wool regulates temperature, breathes naturally, and develops a softer hand with continued wear. Designed with a relaxed silhouette and subtly tailored fit, it features a shawl collar, a full-length silver zipper for versatile layering, a custom corozo button closure, reinforced elbow patches, and hand pockets at the waist. A custom woven label is also placed at the shoulder which functions as integrated eyewear storage, by sliding the temple through to secure the frames.

Spun in Ireland by Donegal Yarns, Kilcarra Tweed is celebrated for its distinctive homespun character. The yarn is created by blending dyed fibers before spinning, producing the signature multicolored flecks that give Donegal tweed its depth and texture. After washing, the wool blooms to reveal an even softer, richer finish while retaining its rugged performance.

Fabric origin: Ireland
Fabric composition: 100% Wool

title: Kohei Aero Blade Ti Graphite, D+ Glacial Mirror
body_html:

The Kohei Aero Blade Ti is a six base rimless blade style proprietary sunglass system featuring a frame composed entirely of ultra lightweight and durable aerospace grade titanium. The frame features custom anodized titanium hardware, hypoallergenic rubber nose pads and temple tips for a fully customizable fit, and utilize our signature D+ therapeutic grade lenses, constructed from shatterproof polycarbonate compound. The lens interiors are treated with both anti-reflective and oleophobic coatings for holistic eye protection and water and oil repellency. Lens shaping and profile draws inspiration from heritage 1980's speed cycling where aerodynamic considerations and protection carry equal weighting. D+ Glacial Mirror was developed for physical pursuits requiring maximum sun protection. The mirror coating facilitates additional infrared screening. The lens offers 100% UVA/B protection while transmitting 10.63% of visible light and 4.05% of blue light.

title: Eiichi Explorer Ti 66N Brown, D+ Brown Gradient
body_html:
Made in Japan.
Developed to commemorate District Vision’s 10th anniversary in 2025, the Eiichi Explorer Ti builds upon the design principles established with the 2015 Keiichi Standard, the brand’s inaugural eyewear model. Named in honor of the late Mr. Eiichi Nakanishi and the Japanese craftsmen he led for over 50 years, the frame is engineered with a 6-base lens curvature and aerospace-grade titanium temples measuring 130mm for exceptional strength and lightweight durability. Designed for 66°North, it features TR90 nylon glare hoods contoured for alpine performance, offering protection against intense sun, wind, rain, and snow in the world’s most extreme climates. To ensure a secure and comfortable fit across a broader range of facial structures, it includes an enlarged, adjustable hypoallergenic nose pad, while shatterproof lenses with advanced oleophobic and anti-reflective coatings preserve optical clarity. D+ Brown Gradient mitigates reflected light and allows 38.1% of visible light transmission, 6.06% of blue light transmission, and blocks 100% of UVA/UVB rays.

*The temple tips on our titanium frames are fixed and cannot be adjusted or rotated.

The result is a traditionally knit, resilient sock that can be worn cuffed, scrunched, or pulled up to the knee. The socks fit men's US Size 7 - 12.

title: Takeyoshi Altitude Master Silver, D+ Photochromic
body_html:
Made in Japan.
The Takeyoshi Altitude Master is an 8 base frame construction designed for rigorous outdoor pursuits. The ergonomic form is engineered to aid ventilation and enhance the field of vision whilst protecting the eyes. The temples are shaped to accommodate helmet use, and adjustable nose pads and temple tips provide a secure, customized fit, reinforced by a grade 2 titanium core for added durability. Our signature D+ therapeutic-grade lenses are crafted from a shatterproof polycarbonate compound. The interior surfaces feature anti-reflective and oleophobic coatings, providing comprehensive eye protection while repelling water and oil. Our D+ Photochromic lenses are rated CAT0-3 and transition from clear to grey in response to UV exposure. In direct sunlight, they reach approximately 20% visible light transmittance within 30 seconds and 15% within 60 seconds. Because the lenses are activated by UV light, they will not darken behind most car windshields or windows, which filter the majority of UV radiation.

title: Ashima Horizon Blade, Clear/D+ Black Rose
body_html:
Made in Japan.

The Ashima Horizon Blade, named after climber Ashima Shiraishi and developed in collaboration with her over two years of iterative testing, is designed around lens geometries specifically optimized for outdoor climbing. Utilizing a 6-base frame construction, the frame incorporates extended peripheral lens coverage for enhanced visual protection. The lens design features four strategically placed ventilation holes near its center, engineered to improve airflow and reduce fogging under dynamic conditions. The 125mm temples are specifically constructed to accommodate helmet use, making the frame suitable for climbing and cycling applications. Adjustable nose pads and temple tips ensure a secure, personalized fit, reinforced with a grade 2 titanium core in the temple tips for added strength. Our signature D+ therapeutic-grade lenses are crafted from a shatterproof polycarbonate compound. The interior surfaces feature anti-reflective and oleophobic coatings, providing comprehensive eye protection while repelling water and oil. D+ Black Rose is an advanced sports lens engineered for trail running and physical pursuits that involve variable light conditions. The lens allows 15.67% of visible light transmittance. The lens also offers 100% UVA/B protection while transmitting 14.19% of blue light.

A non-PFC Durable Water Repellent finish is added for increased water resistance in inclement weather.

title: Ultralight Nylon Wind Jacket, Obsidian
body_html:

The jacket features a wide vent across the back for excess heat ventilation during high-output activities, cinch cords at the waist and easily packs into its own thoughtfully designed rear envelope pocket for keeping close at hand in variable weather conditions. The fabric is also treated with a non-PFC Durable Water Resistant finish for increased water resistance in inclement weather.

title: Yusuke Ti Benjamin Védrines, Graphite/D+ Onyx Mirror
body_html:
Made in Japan.
Developed in collaboration with French alpinist Benjamin Védrines, who holds the record as the fastest person to summit an 8,000-meter peak, known as an eight-thousander. This version of the Yusuke Alpine Blade Ti features a custom lens with edge ventilation to support airflow at high altitudes, designed for the first-ever ascent of Jannu East in October 2025. The frame is a six-base, blade-style proprietary sunglass system composed entirely of lightweight, durable, aerospace-grade titanium. The lens shaping draws inspiration from early alpine and explorer eyewear, where the lens acted as a protective shield for the eyes and face. The lens interiors are treated with both anti-reflective and oleophobic coatings for holistic eye protection and water and oil repellency. D+ Onyx Mirror was developed for physical pursuits requiring maximum sun protection. The mirror coating facilitates additional infrared screening. The lens offers 100% UVA/B protection while transmitting 16.19% of visible light and 15.99% of blue light.

Limited production run of 30 units.

*The temple tips on our titanium frames are fixed and do not rotate. For a precise fit, adjustments can be made by a licensed optician.

title: UDD DX Articulated Down Jacket, Cement
body_html:
Born in 1941 in Maibara City, Shiga Prefecture, Nanga is a manufacturer of down products dedicated to domestic production at Kawada Feather. Down feathers are composed of hard keratin and carbon, making them inherently durable materials. These natural resources have superior properties, allowing them to withstand use for over 100 years, or even 200 years with proper care and processing. To process the raw down, we choose to draw extremely soft water with a hardness level of 3 from a pure source in Mt. Odaigahara. This pristine water requires less detergent and has high penetrating power, allowing it to reach every structural cavity of the down and remove even the finest particles of dirt and oils. Its weak-alkaline properties help revive and repair the feathers. The water quality is perfect for processing down, which is why we chose to activate production for the collection in this area.

The UDD DX Articulated Down Jacket is engineered for superior warmth and comfort in harsh winter conditions. The down sourced from Spain delivers superior loft and natural water-repellency, while an extended stand collar offers enhanced coverage against the elements. Integrated baffle pocketing provides secure chest storage for eyewear alongside zippered hand pockets to protect essentials. Details includes a two-way zipper, custom corozo buttons derived 100% naturally from the seeds of palm trees, anchored on a grosgrain ribbon and cinch cords at the waist for an adjustable fit. Crafted from 100% Japanese nylon taffeta with a dry-to-the-touch finish, the shell fabric delivers lasting durability and feather retention.

Down origin: Spain
Shell fabric origin: Japan
Shell composition: 100% Nylon Taffeta
Shell fabric weight: 45gsm

title: DV + NB SC Elite Mens, Linen
body_html:
With an ultra-lightweight design, full-length carbon fiber plate and an ultra-responsive PEBA midsole, the FuelCell SC Elite is premium performance built for race day. Energy Arc pairs sport-specific carbon fiber plate geometry with strategic midsole voids, designed to increase stored energy to deliver a higher amount of total energy returned. Monochromatic earth tones highlight the shoe’s refined material tactility and artisanal detailing. A red contrast stitch at the heel nods to traditional Japanese finishing methods while suede accents on the lateral “N” and tongue are reenforced with red bar tacks for added texture. Commemorating the collaboration, each shoe includes a removable co-branded coin medallion, reminiscent of a Japanese good-luck token given to co-founder Tom Daly before a marathon in 2014.

Weight: 7.6oz

title: Kohei Aero Blade Ti Graphite, D+ Rose Mirror
body_html:
Made in Japan.
The Kohei Aero Blade Ti is a six base rimless blade style proprietary sunglass system featuring a frame composed entirely of ultra lightweight and durable aerospace grade titanium. The frame features custom anodized titanium hardware, hypoallergenic rubber nose pads, temple tips and utilizes our signature D+ therapeutic grade lenses, constructed from shatterproof polycarbonate compound. The lens interiors are treated with both anti-reflective and oleophobic coatings for holistic eye protection and water and oil repellency. Lens shaping and profile draws inspiration from heritage 1980's speed cycling where aerodynamic considerations and protection carry equal weighting. D+ Rose Mirror is an advanced sports lens engineered for trail running and physical pursuits that involve changing light conditions. The lens has a variable light transmission allowing 15.6% to 35.15% of light through. This enhances visibility in a variety of performance conditions. The lens also offers 100% UVA/B protection while transmitting 14.19% of blue light.

*The temple tips on our titanium frames are fixed and do not rotate. For a precise fit, adjustments can be made by a licensed optician.

title: DV + NB Trail Shoe 2024, Bone
body_html:
The District Vision + New Balance Hierro v8 Trail Running Shoe emphasizes hand-drawn, organic contours over geometric precision, creating a dynamic yet crafted aesthetic reminiscent of the early 2000s running shoe aesthetic.

 

The base print material is translucent ReGrind, a proprietary New Balance recycled compound sourced from car tires and running shoe soles, layered with 3D and rubberized prints for added depth and durability. Key details include a red dot beside the "N," nodding to the brand’s Japanese eyewear endeavors, and an oversized co-branded woven tongue label. A subtle halftone print enriches the bottom mesh layer.

 

The outsole employs Vibram EcoStep Natural technology. Colors are derived from naturally occurring substances: charcoal-based pigments (Carbo Ligni) for the Black design and a titanium dioxide/charcoal blend for the Bone option. The sole composition incorporates over 90% petroleum-free materials, highlighting an intentional focus on reducing environmental impact through advanced material science.

 

*Please note: We recommend sizing up a half size as the shoe runs small.

 

Weight: 11.2oz
